scenes.hook: A video plays the same sequence. A world model can generate a changing environment that responds to actions.
scenes.idea: Give it a scene and an action, and it tries to model what happens next.
scenes.demo: Imagine steering through a generated space rather than simply watching a prerecorded clip. This diagram is only an illustration.
scenes.compare: Researchers explore these models for interactive experiences and environments where agents can practise.
scenes.takeaway: A convincing world can still contain mistakes. Visual realism does not guarantee correct physics or reliable real world behavior.
scenes.close: What would you try in a simulated world? Subscribe to Tech at sixty for tech explained.
